name: Butalbital
aliases: 5-allyl-5-isobutylbarbituric acid, 5-Allyl-5-isobutylbarbituric acid, 5-isobutyl-5-allylbarbituric acid, alisobumal, allylbarbital, allylbarbitone, allylbarbituric acid, Allylbarbituric acid
summary: Butalbital is a barbiturate with an intermediate duration of action. Butalbital is often combined with other medications, such as paracetamol (acetaminophen) (as butalbital/acetaminophen) or aspirin, for the treatment of pain and headache. The various formulations combined with codeine are FDA-approved for the treatment of tension headaches.

sideEffects.text: Side effects for butalbital are usually well tolerated.

summaryZh: 布他比妥（英語：Butalbital）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C11H16N2O3，屬於巴比妥類藥物，與他布比妥是同分異構體，區別在於異丁基變為仲丁基。
summaryZhHans: 布他比妥（英语：Butalbital）是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C11H16N2O3，属于巴比妥类药物，与他布比妥是同分异构体，区别在于异丁基变为仲丁基。
